audit: 2026-09-15 scheduled remote agent (fourth fire of the day): one 48 question batch across all four modules, published as data/batches/sched_multi_topic_2026-09-15_d_1.json through _d_4.json, twelve questions per module. Tier split 24 L3, 20 L4 and 4 L5 with no L2, taking every module to exactly 1573 and the bank to 6292. Cell selection: the live matrix showed L3 sitting 12.0 to 14.7 points and L4 sitting 11.2 to 13.5 points below their per-topic ideals while L5 sat at 5.06 per cent in all four modules, so a strict per-question argmax remains degenerate at this bank size and this is the fifth consecutive fire to record it. Simulated directly it placed 42 of 50 questions in Paediatrics L3 and Obstetrics L3, allocated nothing to Psychiatry or Medicine, and would have widened a module spread that is currently zero out to more than 40, breaching the Section 2 module-balance directive. This fire allocated proportionally to the positive within-topic deficits at 6 L3 to 5 L4 per module, capped per-module counts equally, and placed one L5 in each module, which holds every module at 5.09 per cent, above the 5.00 per cent floor, after adding 11 non-L5 questions each. The routine prompt's per-question selection section should be rewritten as a proportional allocation with an explicit module-balance cap and an L5 floor rule; four prior fires have now recorded the same finding without the prompt changing. Duplicate control: scripts/dupe_gate.py passed the first 48 outright, but running it with --show-review surfaced eight pairs in the 0.62 to 0.80 band, six of which were conceptual duplicates of questions published on 8, 13 and 14 September that the gate scored below threshold because subtopic_detail wording differed while the condition and the correct action were identical: pseudobulbar affect after stroke, congenital nasolacrimal duct obstruction, adenomyosis treated with a levonorgestrel intrauterine system, Charles Bonnet syndrome, carbon monoxide poisoning and rhabdomyolysis. All six were replaced in the same cell with the same answer letter. The first replacement for the Paediatrics slot, a toddler's fracture item, was itself caught in the review band against a 9 September question at answer similarity 0.87, and was replaced a second time with pubertal gynaecomastia. Note the recurring failure mode: a keyword screen of subtopic_detail returned zero prior hits for carbon monoxide, melioidosis and toddler's fracture because the earlier questions never name the condition in that field. Recommendation, repeating the 2026-09-15c recommendation: extend the gate to compare stems as well as subtopic_detail, and treat the --show-review band as mandatory rather than optional in the run procedure, since the gate alone passed a batch containing seven conceptual duplicates. Final gate run returned zero duplicates and zero review band pairs. Coverage added, chosen from ground the bank had not touched: Paediatrics on pubertal gynaecomastia, internal tibial torsion, nutritional rickets in a prolonged breastfed toddler, recurrent anterior epistaxis, labial adhesions, physiological phimosis with ballooning, periodic fever with aphthous stomatitis pharyngitis and adenitis, Perthes disease, leukocoria and the absent red reflex, ankyloglossia with maternal nipple trauma, chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis, and medium chain acyl coenzyme A dehydrogenase deficiency presenting as hypoketotic hypoglycaemia in a child who had no newborn screening; Obstetrics and Gynaecology on imperforate hymen with urinary retention, nipple vasospasm, pelvic girdle pain, carpal tunnel syndrome in pregnancy, galactocele in lactation, tubo-ovarian abscess, red degeneration of a fibroid in pregnancy, Bartholin abscess needing wall biopsy after forty, intrauterine adhesions after repeated curettage, mode of birth after obstetric anal sphincter injury, provoked vestibulodynia, and heterotopic pregnancy after embryo transfer where methotrexate is contraindicated; Psychiatry on delayed sleep wake phase disorder, trichotillomania, hoarding disorder, premenstrual dysphoric disorder with luteal phase dosing, transfer to a long acting injectable after non-adherence relapse, prescription opioid tapering with real time prescription monitoring, Korsakoff syndrome with confabulation, zolpidem complex sleep behaviour, primary polydipsia with seizure requiring hypertonic saline, lithium induced nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, tardive dyskinesia, and delusional misidentification in Lewy body disease with neuroleptic sensitivity; Medicine on benign paroxysmal positional vertigo, trigeminal neuralgia, statin associated muscle symptoms and rechallenge, polymyalgia rheumatica, periprocedural contrast planning with the metformin threshold at 30 mL/min/1.73m2, denosumab discontinuation rebound, Q fever in an abattoir worker, malignant spinal cord compression, melioidosis in the tropical wet season, accidental hypothermia with J waves, hungry bone syndrome after parathyroidectomy, and Waldenstrom hyperviscosity where transfusion and rituximab are both acutely harmful.
